source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    s.name AS SourceSchema,
    t.name AS SourceTable,
    t.temporal_type_desc AS TableType,

    CAST(N'SELECT ' AS nvarchar(max))
    + STRING_AGG(
        CAST(
            CASE
                -- Preserve spatial values as SQL Server native binary.
                WHEN ty.name IN (N'geography', N'geometry')
                THEN
                    N'CASE WHEN ' + QUOTENAME(c.name)
                    + N' IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE '
                    + QUOTENAME(c.name)
                    + N'.Serialize() END AS '
                    + QUOTENAME(c.name)

                -- Preserve full datetime2 precision in raw files.
                WHEN ty.name = N'datetime2'
                THEN
                    N'CONVERT(varchar(33), '
                    + QUOTENAME(c.name)
                    + N', 126) AS '
                    + QUOTENAME(c.name)

                ELSE QUOTENAME(c.name)
            END
            AS nvarchar(max)
        ),
        N', '
    ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.column_id)

    + N' FROM '
    + QUOTENAME(s.name) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(t.name)
    + N';' AS SourceQuery

FROM sys.tables AS t
JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns AS c
    ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types AS ty
    ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id

WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0
  AND s.name IN (
      N'Application',
      N'Purchasing',
      N'Sales',
      N'Warehouse'
  )

GROUP BY
    s.name,
    t.name,
    t.temporal_type_desc

ORDER BY
    s.name,
    t.name;
